# Company Planning

Read this page before searching the repository. A search returns lines that
matched a pattern and says nothing about whether they are current or binding.

## What this repository is

Company Planning is Brian's planning method, packaged as the `company-planning`
plugin for Codex and Claude Code: nine skills (initiative roadmaps, bounded
design, landscape review, work-unit graphs, claiming, evidence-first
implementation, plan execution, deployment readiness, deploy-work-unit) plus the
validators, schemas, hooks and evals behind them. Per the
2026-09-14 decision (ADR-2026-09-14 in project-meta's ops docs)
it is the single planning method for Brian's personal repositories and for
Inside Success.

Canonical source: `BrianMills2718/company-planning` (remote `origin`). The
company copy `Inside-Success/company-planning` (remote `inside-success`) is an
automatic mirror of `main` since 2026-10-08, and Inside Success teammates install
and update from it ([details](../README.md#canonical-home-and-downstream-copy)).
The 2026-10-02 update (one-time handoff PRs), the 2026-10-04 update (company copy
as distribution source), the 2026-10-06 reversal (personal repository is
canonical again) and the 2026-10-08 mirror are in the decision record.

## Where the live docs are

The product lives under `plugins/company-planning/`; the root directories are
routing and lifecycle controls, not a relocation.

| Question | Live authority |
| --- | --- |
| What is the product, how do I install and update it? | [Repository README](../README.md), the plugin's own README under [plugins/company-planning/](../plugins/company-planning/) |
| What outcome is current, and in what order? | INITIATIVE_ROADMAP.md in the [plugin docs](../plugins/company-planning/docs/); root [roadmap/](../roadmap/README.md) only routes there |

| Which execution plans exist? | [plugin plans](../plugins/company-planning/docs/plans/) |

| What must the adoption gate and completion do? | [requirements](../docs/architecture/REQUIREMENTS.md), each with its success check and disproof |

| Why was a rule decided that way? | [decision records](../docs/decisions/): [0001 adoption requires a receipt](../docs/decisions/0001-plan-adoption-requires-a-receipt.md), [0002 checked system model](../docs/decisions/0002-every-project-has-a-checked-system-model.md), [0003 durable documents](../docs/decisions/0003-plans-keep-durable-documents-current.md) |
| What does the plan-adoption gate store, write and show? | [system model](../docs/model/ODD.md) and its [view coverage](../docs/model/VIEW_COVERAGE.md) (adoption gate only so far) |

## Code, tests and usage

- Implementation: [plugins/company-planning/scripts/](../plugins/company-planning/scripts/)
  (validators, plan execution, dashboard projection) and root [src/](../src/),
  which only routes to the plugin.
- Tests: [tests/](../tests/). From the repository root,
  `python3 -m pytest` runs the whole suite (`pytest.ini` sets the path); the
  integrated local run on 2026-10-09 was 824 passed, exit 0. There is no Makefile and no
  `pyproject.toml`.

- After editing packaged content, refresh the cachebuster in both plugin
  manifests ([README Validate](../README.md#validate)).

- Enforced Planning no longer defines a separate planning method; it keeps claims,

5	# 0001 Plan adoption requires a passing conformance receipt
6	
7	Governs: RULE-ADOPT-RECEIPT, RULE-SOURCE-PIN
8	
9	**Decision.** A plan is adopted only through one gate: a method conformance receipt
10	compiled from the selected planning path and its activated overlays, in which every
11	blocking item passes with evidence. The receipt is pinned to the exact plan and to the
12	method sources (skill and design, by commit and sha256) it was compiled from, so a
13	changed source must be re-pinned before plans compile again.

# 0001 Plan adoption requires a passing conformance receipt

Governs: RULE-ADOPT-RECEIPT, RULE-SOURCE-PIN

**Decision.** A plan is adopted only through one gate: a method conformance receipt
compiled from the selected planning path and its activated overlays, in which every
blocking item passes with evidence. The receipt is pinned to the exact plan and to the
method sources (skill and design, by commit and sha256) it was compiled from, so a
changed source must be re-pinned before plans compile again.

**Why.** Prompt-only guidance and self-attestation let an agent claim compliance
without inspectable evidence; one universal static checklist becomes ceremony and
lets "not applicable" hide missing work; copying the rules into every client hook
makes copies that drift into competing policy owners.

"""Receipt validator and the plugin-owned plan-adoption gate.

``evaluate`` recompiles the definition from the exact plan, route, and facts;
validates the agent's observation bundle with the existing checklist
validator; checks each item structurally, by evidence, and (when declared)
semantically; and returns one ``PlanningMethodConformanceReceiptV1``.
``adopt`` writes that receipt to the path the plan declares and records the
adoption decision. A missing semantic verifier yields ``unavailable``, never a
pass.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import time
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any

from method_conformance import compiler
from method_conformance.common import (
    PLUGIN_ROOT,
    RECEIPT_FRONT_MATTER_KEY,
    MethodConformanceError,
    canonical_sha256,
    checklist_module,
    dump_json,
    feedback_module,
    load_json,
    now_iso,
    plan_front_matter,
    relative_ref,
    resolve_ref,
    safe_id,
    schema_errors,
    sha256_bytes,
    sha256_file,
    split_evidence_ref,
    write_json,
)
from method_conformance.first_try import CachedVerifier, cache_path_for
from method_conformance.semantic import DisabledVerifier, SemanticResult, SemanticVerifier

STATUS_TO_DISPOSITION = {"pass": "pass", "fail": "unresolved", "inconclusive": "unresolved", "not_applicable": "not_applicable"}


@dataclass
class GateInputs:
    repo_root: Path
    plan_path: Path
    path_decision_path: Path
    facts_path: Path
    bundle_path: Path
    profile_id: str = "bounded-design"


def _caller(client: str | None, session: str | None) -> dict[str, Any]:
    if client is None:
        if os.environ.get("CLAUDECODE"):
            client = "claude-code"
        elif any(key.startswith("CODEX_") for key in os.environ):
            client = "codex"
        else:
            client = "cli"
    session = (
        session
        or os.environ.get("CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID")
        or os.environ.get("CLAUDE_SESSION_ID")
        or os.environ.get("CODEX_THREAD_ID")
    )
    return {"client": client, "session": session}


def _item_result(item: dict[str, Any], meta: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        "item_id": item["item_id"],
        "effect": item["effect"],
        "applicability_mode": item["applicability"]["mode"],
        "condition_fact": meta["condition_fact"],
        "condition_value": meta["condition_value"],
        "verifier_kind": meta["verifier"],
        "disposition": "missing",
        "verifier_result": "fail",
        "reason_codes": [],
        "evidence": [],
        "semantic": None,
        "suggested_action": None,
    }


def _resolve_evidence(repo_root: Path, ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str]:
    """Return (repo-relative path, sha256, excerpt) for one evidence reference."""
    path_text, pointer = split_evidence_ref(ref)
    path = resolve_ref(repo_root, path_text)
    if not path.is_file():
        raise MethodConformanceError("evidence_missing", f"evidence file {path_text} does not exist")
    content = path.read_bytes()
    text = content.decode("utf-8")
    if pointer is None:
        excerpt: Any = text
    else:
        try:
            excerpt = checklist_module().resolve_source_pointer(text, pointer)
        except ValueError as exc:
            raise MethodConformanceError("evidence_pointer_unresolved", f"{ref}: {exc}") from exc
    if not isinstance(excerpt, str):
        import json

        excerpt = json.dumps(excerpt, indent=2)
    return relative_ref(repo_root, path), sha256_bytes(content), excerpt


def evaluate(
    inputs: GateInputs,
    *,
    verifier: SemanticVerifier | None = None,
    client: str | None = None,
    session: str | None = None,
    use_verdict_cache: bool = True,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    started = time.monotonic()
    started_at = now_iso()
    verifier = verifier or DisabledVerifier()
    repo_root = inputs.repo_root.resolve()
    plan_bytes = inputs.plan_path.read_bytes()
    plan_sha = sha256_bytes(plan_bytes)
    plan_ref = relative_ref(repo_root, inputs.plan_path)
    path_ref = relative_ref(repo_root, inputs.path_decision_path)
    facts_ref = relative_ref(repo_root, inputs.facts_path)
    bundle_ref = relative_ref(repo_root, inputs.bundle_path)
    path_sha = sha256_file(inputs.path_decision_path)
    facts_sha = sha256_file(inputs.facts_path)
    bundle_sha = sha256_file(inputs.bundle_path)
    path_record = load_json(inputs.path_decision_path)
    facts_record = load_json(inputs.facts_path)
    bundle = load_json(inputs.bundle_path)
    plan_id = safe_id(Path(plan_ref).stem)

    reason_codes: list[str] = []
    summary: list[str] = []
    limitations: list[str] = []
    items_out: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    compiled: compiler.CompiledProfile | None = None
    profile_info = {"profile_id": inputs.profile_id, "revision": "unresolved", "path": f"contracts/method-conformance/profiles/{inputs.profile_id}.v1.json", "sha256": "0" * 64}
    try:
        compiled = compiler.compile_profile(
            profile_id=inputs.profile_id,
            plan_ref=plan_ref,
            plan_sha256=plan_sha,
            path_record=path_record,
            path_sha256=path_sha,
            facts_record=facts_record,
            facts_sha256=facts_sha,
            repo_root=repo_root,
        )
        profile_info = {
            "profile_id": inputs.profile_id,
            "revision": compiled.profile["revision"],
            "path": compiled.profile_path.relative_to(PLUGIN_ROOT).as_posix(),
            "sha256": compiled.profile_sha256,
        }
    except MethodConformanceError as exc:
        reason_codes.append(exc.code)
        summary.append(f"{exc.code}: {exc}")

    checklist_info: dict[str, Any] = {
        "checklist_id": None, "revision": None, "definition_sha256": None,
        "bundle_ref": bundle_ref, "bundle_sha256": bundle_sha,
        "coverage": bundle.get("coverage") if isinstance(bundle, dict) else None,
        "definition_matches_recompilation": False,
    }
    semantic_jobs: list[tuple[dict[str, Any], str, str]] = []
    if compiled is not None:
        definition = compiled.definition
        checklist_info.update({
            "checklist_id": definition["checklist_id"],
            "revision": definition["revision"],
            "definition_sha256": compiled.definition_sha256,
        })
        bundle_definition = bundle.get("definition") if isinstance(bundle, dict) else None
        matches = isinstance(bundle_definition, dict) and canonical_sha256(bundle_definition) == compiled.definition_sha256
        checklist_info["definition_matches_recompilation"] = matches
        if not matches:
            reason_codes.append("definition_stale")
            summary.append(
                "definition_stale: the observation bundle was compiled for different route, facts, plan, "
                "profile, or compiler revisions; re-run `compile` and re-record observations"
            )
        bundle_errors = checklist_module().validate_bundle(bundle, verify_sources=False)
        if bundle_errors:
            reason_codes.append("bundle_invalid")
            summary.extend(f"bundle_invalid: {error}" for error in bundle_errors[:10])
        if bundle.get("coverage") != "complete":
            reason_codes.append("coverage_incomplete")
        observations = {
            obs.get("item_id"): obs
            for obs in (bundle.get("observations") or [])
            if isinstance(obs, dict)
        }
        for item in definition["items"]:
            meta = compiled.item_meta[item["item_id"]]
            result = _item_result(item, meta)
            items_out.append(result)
            obs = observations.get(item["item_id"]) if matches else None
            if obs is None:
                result["reason_codes"].append("missing_observation")
                result["suggested_action"] = f"Record an observation for {item['item_id']} with evidence."
                continue
            evidence = obs["evidence"]
            status = evidence["status"]
            result["disposition"] = STATUS_TO_DISPOSITION[status]
            if evidence["source_revision"] != f"sha256:{plan_sha}":
                result["disposition"] = "unresolved"
                result["reason_codes"].append("stale_observation")
                result["suggested_action"] = "Re-record this observation against the current plan revision."
                continue
            if status == "not_applicable":
                if item["applicability"]["mode"] == "required":
                    result["reason_codes"].append("required_item_not_applicable")
                    result["suggested_action"] = f"{item['item_id']} is required on this route; provide evidence instead of not_applicable."
                elif meta["condition_value"] is not False:
                    result["reason_codes"].append("false_not_applicable")
                    result["suggested_action"] = (
                        f"{item['item_id']} is active because {meta['condition_fact']}=true; "
                        "provide evidence or correct the declared fact."
                    )
                else:
                    result["verifier_result"] = "pass"
                continue
            if status in ("fail", "inconclusive"):
                result["reason_codes"].append(f"agent_reported_{status}")
                result["suggested_action"] = obs.get("annotation")
                continue
            # status == pass: verify the cited evidence.
            refs = [evidence["evidence_ref"]]
            try:
                resolved = [_resolve_evidence(repo_root, ref) for ref in refs]
            except MethodConformanceError as exc:
                result["disposition"] = "unresolved"
                result["reason_codes"].append(exc.code)
                result["suggested_action"] = str(exc)
                continue
            result["evidence"] = [{"ref": ref, "sha256": digest} for ref, (_p, digest, _e) in zip(refs, resolved)]
            cited_paths = {path for path, _digest, _excerpt in resolved}
            if meta["verifier"] == "structural":
                if path_ref not in cited_paths:
                    result["disposition"] = "unresolved"
                    result["reason_codes"].append("evidence_type_mismatch")
                    result["suggested_action"] = f"Cite the path-decision record {path_ref}."
                elif compiled.path_errors:
                    result["disposition"] = "unresolved"
                    result["reason_codes"].append("route_mismatch")
                    result["suggested_action"] = "; ".join(compiled.path_errors)
                else:
                    result["verifier_result"] = "pass"
                continue
            if "plan_section" in item["evidence_required"] or "plan_document" in item["evidence_required"]:
                if plan_ref not in cited_paths:
                    result["disposition"] = "unresolved"
                    result["reason_codes"].append("evidence_not_in_plan")
                    result["suggested_action"] = f"Cite a section of the plan {plan_ref} itself."
                    continue
            if meta["verifier"] == "evidence":
                result["verifier_result"] = "pass"
                continue
            excerpt = "\n\n".join(text for _p, _d, text in resolved)
            if "activation_facts_record" in item["evidence_required"]:
                import json

                excerpt = (
                    "FULL PLAN:\n" + plan_bytes.decode("utf-8")
                    + "\n\nDECLARED ACTIVATION FACTS:\n" + json.dumps(_facts_for_review(compiled, facts_record), indent=2)
                )
            semantic_jobs.append((result, item["statement"], excerpt))

    cached: CachedVerifier | None = None
    if semantic_jobs and use_verdict_cache and verifier.kind != "disabled":
        # Plan 56: reuse a verdict while the exact judged text is unchanged, so an unchanged
        # section is not re-litigated and cannot flip between runs.
        cached = CachedVerifier(verifier, cache_path_for(inputs.plan_path))
    if semantic_jobs:
        digest = hashlib.sha256(f"{plan_sha}:{started_at}".encode()).hexdigest()[:12]
        reviewer = cached or verifier

        def run(job: tuple[dict[str, Any], str, str]) -> SemanticResult:
            result, statement, excerpt = job
            return reviewer.review(
                item_id=result["item_id"],
                statement=statement,
                evidence=excerpt,
                trace_id=f"company-planning/method-conformance/{plan_id}/{digest}/{result['item_id']}",
            )

        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=6) as pool:
            outcomes = list(pool.map(run, semantic_jobs))
        for (result, _statement, _excerpt), outcome in zip(semantic_jobs, outcomes):
            result["semantic"] = {
                "trace_id": outcome.trace_id,
                "model": outcome.model,
                "verdict": outcome.verdict,
                "materiality": outcome.materiality,
                "missing": outcome.missing if outcome.verdict != "unavailable" else outcome.error,
                "rationale": outcome.rationale,
                "reused": bool(cached and result["item_id"] in cached.reused),
            }
            if outcome.verdict == "pass":
                result["verifier_result"] = "pass"
            elif outcome.verdict == "unavailable":
                result["verifier_result"] = "unavailable"
                result["reason_codes"].append("semantic_verifier_unavailable")
                result["suggested_action"] = "Re-run adoption when the semantic verifier is reachable."
            else:
                result["disposition"] = "unresolved"
                result["reason_codes"].append("semantic_unresolved")
                result["suggested_action"] = f"Add to the plan: {outcome.missing}" if outcome.missing else outcome.rationale

    if cached is not None:
        cached.save()
    counts = {"pass": 0, "unresolved": 0, "not_applicable": 0, "unavailable": 0, "missing": 0}
    blocking_fail = blocking_unavailable = False
    deviations: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for result in items_out:
        if result["verifier_result"] == "unavailable":
            counts["unavailable"] += 1
        elif result["disposition"] == "missing":
            counts["missing"] += 1
        elif result["verifier_result"] == "pass":
            counts["pass" if result["disposition"] == "pass" else "not_applicable"] += 1
        else:
            counts["unresolved"] += 1
        if result["verifier_result"] == "pass":
            continue
        if result["effect"] == "advisory":
            if result["verifier_result"] == "fail":
                deviations.append(result)
            continue
        if result["verifier_result"] == "unavailable":
            blocking_unavailable = True
        else:
            blocking_fail = True
        for code in result["reason_codes"]:
            if code not in reason_codes:
                reason_codes.append(code)
        summary.append(f"{result['item_id']}: {', '.join(result['reason_codes'])} -> {result['suggested_action']}")

    if compiled is None or blocking_fail or any(
        code in reason_codes for code in ("definition_stale", "bundle_invalid", "coverage_incomplete")
    ):
        overall = "fail"
    elif blocking_unavailable:
        overall = "unavailable"
    else:
        overall = "pass"
    semantic_available = not any(
        (r["semantic"] or {}).get("verdict") == "unavailable" for r in items_out
    ) and verifier.kind != "disabled"
    if not semantic_available:
        limitations.append("Semantic verifier was unavailable for at least one item; no semantic item counted as passing without it.")
    limitations.append(
        "Semantic verdicts judge only the cited plan excerpt against the item statement; they do not judge product strategy."
    )

    receipt_id = f"RECEIPT-{plan_id}-{plan_sha[:12]}"
    advisory = []
    for result in deviations:
        feedback_id = "FEEDBACK-MCR-" + hashlib.sha256(f"{receipt_id}:{result['item_id']}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
        advisory.append({
            "item_id": result["item_id"],
            "reason_codes": list(result["reason_codes"]),
            "feedback_id": feedback_id,
            "feedback_status": "not_recorded",
        })
    report = None
    if compiled is not None:
        report = _conformance_report(
            plan_id=plan_id, plan_ref=plan_ref, plan_sha=plan_sha, bundle_sha=bundle_sha,
            route=compiled.route, items=items_out, reason_codes=reason_codes,
            semantic_available=semantic_available, limitations=limitations,
        )
    receipt = {
        "schema_version": "planning-method-conformance-receipt.v1",
        "record_type": "planning_method_conformance_receipt",
        "receipt_id": receipt_id,
        "plan": {"plan_ref": plan_ref, "plan_sha256": plan_sha},
        "path_decision": {
            "ref": path_ref, "sha256": path_sha,
            "selected_path": path_record.get("selected_path") if isinstance(path_record, dict) else None,
            "classified_path": compiled.classified_path if compiled else None,
            "errors": compiled.path_errors if compiled else [],
        },
        "route": compiled.route if compiled else None,
        "profile": profile_info,
        "compiler": {"path": compiler.COMPILER_PATH.relative_to(PLUGIN_ROOT).as_posix(), "sha256": compiler.compiler_sha256()},
        "activation": {
            "facts_ref": facts_ref, "facts_sha256": facts_sha,
            "facts": compiled.facts if compiled else dict(facts_record.get("facts", {})),
            "fact_origins": compiled.fact_origins if compiled else {},
            "overlays": compiled.overlays if compiled else [],
        },
        "checklist": checklist_info,
        "items": items_out,
        "item_counts": counts,
        "semantic_verifier": {
            "kind": verifier.kind, "available": semantic_available,
            "model": getattr(verifier, "model", None),
            "task": "company_planning.method_conformance.semantic_item_review" if verifier.kind == "llm_client" else None,
        },
        "conformance_report": report,
        "advisory_deviations": advisory,
        "result": overall,
        "reason_codes": [] if overall == "pass" else reason_codes,
        "actionable_summary": summary if overall != "pass" else [
            f"pass: {counts['pass']} items evidenced, {counts['not_applicable']} confirmed not applicable, "
            f"{len(advisory)} advisory deviation(s)"
        ],
        "limitations": limitations,
        "caller": _caller(client, session),
        "started_at": started_at,
        "completed_at": now_iso(),
        "duration_ms": int((time.monotonic() - started) * 1000),
    }
    return receipt


def _conformance_report(
    *, plan_id: str, plan_ref: str, plan_sha: str, bundle_sha: str, route: str,
    items: list[dict[str, Any]], reason_codes: list[str], semantic_available: bool, limitations: list[str],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    diagnostics: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    structural_fail = False
    material_semantic = False
    for index, result in enumerate(items):
        if result["verifier_result"] == "pass":
            continue
        semantic = result["semantic"]
        is_semantic = semantic is not None and semantic["verdict"] in ("unresolved", "unavailable")
        code = (result["reason_codes"] or ["unresolved"])[0].upper().replace("_", "-")
        if is_semantic:
            material = semantic.get("materiality") != "non_material"
            material_semantic = material_semantic or material
            diagnostics.append({
                "diagnostic_id": f"DIAG-{plan_id}-{index}",
                "class": "semantic",
                "severity": "warning",
                "rule_id": f"PL-MCR-{code}",
                "message": f"{result['item_id']}: {semantic.get('missing') or semantic.get('rationale') or semantic['verdict']}",
                "source_locator": plan_ref,
                "materiality": "material" if material else "non_material",
                "suggested_action": result["suggested_action"],
                "disposition": "unresolved",
                "trace_id": semantic["trace_id"],
            })
        else:
            blocking = result["effect"] == "blocking"
            structural_fail = structural_fail or blocking
            diagnostics.append({
                "diagnostic_id": f"DIAG-{plan_id}-{index}",
                "class": "deterministic",
                "severity": "error" if blocking else "warning",
                "rule_id": f"PL-MCR-{code}",
                "message": f"{result['item_id']}: {', '.join(result['reason_codes']) or 'unresolved'}",
                "source_locator": plan_ref,
                "materiality": "material" if blocking else "non_material",
                "suggested_action": result["suggested_action"],
                "disposition": "unresolved",
                "trace_id": None,
            })
    for code in reason_codes:
        if code in ("definition_stale", "bundle_invalid", "coverage_incomplete"):
            structural_fail = True
            diagnostics.append({
                "diagnostic_id": f"DIAG-{plan_id}-{code}",
                "class": "deterministic", "severity": "error",
                "rule_id": f"PL-MCR-{code.upper().replace('_', '-')}",
                "message": code, "source_locator": plan_ref, "materiality": "material",
                "suggested_action": None, "disposition": "unresolved", "trace_id": None,
            })
    report_limitations = list(dict.fromkeys(limitations))
    if structural_fail:
        readiness = "structurally_blocked"
        # PlanningConformanceReportV1 cannot hold an unresolved material semantic
        # finding while structurally blocked (it would require two readiness
        # values). Keep the report valid; the receipt items keep every finding.
        withheld = [d for d in diagnostics if d["class"] == "semantic"]
        if withheld:
            diagnostics = [d for d in diagnostics if d["class"] != "semantic"]
            report_limitations.append(
                f"{len(withheld)} semantic finding(s) are withheld from this report while it is structurally "
                "blocked; see the receipt items for each one."
            )
    elif material_semantic:
        readiness = "contributor_disposition_needed"
    else:
        readiness = "ready_for_contributor"
    return {
        "schema_version": "1.0",
        "record_type": "planning_conformance_report",
        "report_id": f"REPORT-{plan_id}-{plan_sha[:12]}",
        "snapshot_ref": f"SNAPSHOT-{plan_id}",
        "snapshot_revision": f"sha256:{bundle_sha}",
        "packet_ref": plan_ref,
        "packet_revision": f"sha256:{plan_sha}",
        "structural_status": "fail" if structural_fail else "pass",
        "semantic_review_status": "complete" if semantic_available else "unavailable",
        "diagnostics": diagnostics,
        "route": route,
        "adoption_readiness": readiness,
        "limitations": report_limitations,
    }


def record_feedback(receipt: dict[str, Any], repo_root: Path) -> None:
    """Link each advisory deviation to an attributable, content-free feedback entry."""
    if not receipt["advisory_deviations"]:
        return
    module = feedback_module()
    override = os.environ.get("METHOD_CONFORMANCE_FEEDBACK_DIR")
    if override:
        module.LOG_DIR = Path(override)
    paused = module.read_pause()
    existing = module.LOG_DIR / f"{receipt['profile']['profile_id']}.jsonl"
    seen = existing.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if existing.is_file() else ""
    for deviation in receipt["advisory_deviations"]:
        if paused:
            deviation["feedback_status"] = "paused"
            continue
        if deviation["feedback_id"] in seen:
            deviation["feedback_status"] = "recorded"  # the same plan revision already linked it
            continue
        entry = module._context(str(repo_root))
        entry.update({
            "skill": receipt["profile"]["profile_id"],
            "source": "method_conformance",
            "feedback_id": deviation["feedback_id"],
            "receipt_id": receipt["receipt_id"],
            "profile_revision": receipt["profile"]["revision"],
            "item_id": deviation["item_id"],
            "reason_codes": deviation["reason_codes"],
            "plan_sha256": receipt["plan"]["plan_sha256"],
        })
        module._write(entry)
        deviation["feedback_status"] = "recorded"


def declared_receipt_path(repo_root: Path, plan_path: Path) -> Path:
    front = plan_front_matter(plan_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    declared = front.get(RECEIPT_FRONT_MATTER_KEY)
    if not isinstance(declared, str) or not declared:
        raise MethodConformanceError(
            "receipt_path_undeclared",
            f"plan front matter must declare `{RECEIPT_FRONT_MATTER_KEY}: <repository-relative path>` "
            "before adoption, so plan-backed claims can resolve the receipt",
        )
    return resolve_ref(repo_root, declared)


def decision_path_for(receipt_path: Path) -> Path:
    name = receipt_path.name
    stem = name[: -len(".json")] if name.endswith(".json") else name
    if stem.endswith(".receipt"):
        stem = stem[: -len(".receipt")]
    return receipt_path.with_name(f"{stem}.adoption-decision.json")


def attempts_path_for(decision_path: Path) -> Path:
    """Sibling append-only log of every adoption attempt (``<plan>.adoption-attempts.jsonl``)."""
    return decision_path.with_name(decision_path.name.replace(".adoption-decision.json", ".adoption-attempts.jsonl"))


ROUTE_FIT_ANSWERS = ("fits", "does_not_fit")


def append_attempt(decision_path: Path, receipt: dict[str, Any], decision: dict[str, Any],
                   route_fit: dict[str, Any] | None = None) -> Path:
    """Append one line per adoption attempt, refused or adopted.

    The decision file holds only the latest outcome, so a plan refused three times and then adopted
    looked adopted on the first try (meeting-claims-true K5). This line is what makes refusals and
    rework countable.
    """
    path = attempts_path_for(decision_path)
    line = {
        "record_type": "method_adoption_attempt",
        "attempted_at": decision["decided_at"],
        "decision": decision["decision"],
        "receipt_result": receipt["result"],
        "route": receipt["route"],
        "plan_ref": decision["plan_ref"],
        "plan_sha256": decision["plan_sha256"],
        "reason_codes": list(decision["reason_codes"]),
        "not_passed_items": sorted(r["item_id"] for r in receipt["items"] if r.get("disposition") not in ("pass", "not_applicable")),
        "route_fit": route_fit,
    }
    with path.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
        handle.write(json.dumps(line, sort_keys=True) + "\n")
    return path


def record_route_fit(receipt: dict[str, Any], repo_root: Path, route_fit: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    """Log the adopter's answer to "does this route fit the work?" to the skill-feedback outbox.

    Returns "recorded" or "paused". ``scripts/route_fit_reader.py`` reads these lines back and opens
    one keyed concern when the same route is reported as a mismatch more than once.
    """
    module = feedback_module()
    override = os.environ.get("METHOD_CONFORMANCE_FEEDBACK_DIR")
    if override:
        module.LOG_DIR = Path(override)
    if module.read_pause():
        return "paused"
    entry = module._context(str(repo_root))
    entry.update({
        "record_type": "route_fit_answer",
        "skill": receipt["profile"]["profile_id"],
        "source": "route_fit",
        "route": receipt["route"],
        "route_fit": route_fit["answer"],
        "reason": route_fit.get("reason"),
        "better_route": route_fit.get("better_route"),
        "plan_ref": receipt["plan"]["plan_ref"],
        "plan_sha256": receipt["plan"]["plan_sha256"],
        "receipt_id": receipt["receipt_id"],
    })
    module._write(entry)
    return "recorded"


def adopt(
    inputs: GateInputs,
    *,
    verifier: SemanticVerifier | None = None,
    client: str | None = None,
    session: str | None = None,
    record_method_feedback: bool = True,
    route_fit: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], Path, dict[str, Any], Path]:
    """Evaluate and write receipt + adoption decision. Never adopts without a pass.

    Every call also appends one line to ``<plan>.adoption-attempts.jsonl``; the decision file keeps
    only the latest outcome.
    """
    receipt_path = declared_receipt_path(inputs.repo_root, inputs.plan_path)
    receipt = evaluate(inputs, verifier=verifier, client=client, session=session)
    if record_method_feedback:
        record_feedback(receipt, inputs.repo_root)
    errors = schema_errors("receipt", receipt)
    if errors:
        raise MethodConformanceError("receipt_invalid", "; ".join(errors))
    receipt_sha = write_json(receipt_path, receipt)
    decision = {
        "schema_version": "method-adoption-decision.v1",
        "record_type": "method_adoption_decision",
        "decision": "adopted" if receipt["result"] == "pass" else "refused",
        "plan_ref": receipt["plan"]["plan_ref"],
        "plan_sha256": receipt["plan"]["plan_sha256"],
        "receipt_ref": relative_ref(inputs.repo_root, receipt_path),
        "receipt_sha256": receipt_sha,
        "receipt_result": receipt["result"],
        "reason_codes": receipt["reason_codes"],
        "summary": receipt["actionable_summary"],
        "decided_at": now_iso(),
    }
    errors = schema_errors("decision", decision)
    if errors:
        raise MethodConformanceError("decision_invalid", "; ".join(errors))
    decision_path = decision_path_for(receipt_path)
    write_json(decision_path, decision)
    if route_fit is not None and record_method_feedback:
        route_fit["feedback_status"] = record_route_fit(receipt, inputs.repo_root, route_fit)  # caller prints it
    append_attempt(decision_path, receipt, decision, route_fit)
    return receipt, receipt_path, decision, decision_path


def record_observation(
    *,
    repo_root: Path,
    bundle_path: Path,
    plan_path: Path,
    item_id: str,
    status: str,
    evidence_ref: str,
    annotation: str | None,
    not_applicable_reason: str | None,
    producer: str,
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Write one ChecklistItemObservationV1 into the bundle (one per item)."""
    bundle = load_json(bundle_path)
    definition = bundle["definition"]
    items = {item["item_id"]: item for item in definition["items"]}
    if item_id not in items:
        raise MethodConformanceError("unknown_item", f"{item_id} is not in the compiled definition; compiled items: {sorted(items)}")
    if status in ("fail", "inconclusive", "not_applicable") and not annotation:
        raise MethodConformanceError("annotation_required", f"status {status} requires --annotation")
    if status == "not_applicable" and not not_applicable_reason:
        raise MethodConformanceError("annotation_required", "not_applicable requires --not-applicable-reason")
    plan_sha = sha256_file(plan_path)
    evidence: dict[str, Any] = {
        "schema_version": "1.0",
        "record_type": "evidence_record",
        "evidence_id": f"EVIDENCE-{item_id}",
        "criterion_id": item_id,
        "status": status,
        "evidence_ref": evidence_ref,
        "scope": f"plan:{relative_ref(repo_root, plan_path)}",
        "observed_at": now_iso(),
        "producer": producer,
        "source_revision": f"sha256:{plan_sha}",
        "limitations": [],
    }
    if status == "not_applicable":
        evidence["not_applicable_reason"] = not_applicable_reason
    observation = {
        "schema_version": "checklist-item-observation.v1",
        "record_type": "checklist_item_observation",
        "observation_id": f"OBS-{item_id}",
        "checklist_id": definition["checklist_id"],
        "checklist_revision": definition["revision"],
        "definition_sha256": canonical_sha256(definition),
        "item_id": item_id,
        "evidence_types": list(items[item_id]["evidence_required"]),
        "evidence": evidence,
        "annotation": annotation,
    }
    errors = schema_errors("observation", observation)
    if errors:
        raise MethodConformanceError("observation_invalid", "; ".join(errors))
    observations = [obs for obs in bundle["observations"] if obs["item_id"] != item_id]
    observations.append(observation)
    observations.sort(key=lambda obs: [i["item_id"] for i in definition["items"]].index(obs["item_id"]))
    bundle["observations"] = observations
    bundle["coverage"] = "complete" if {o["item_id"] for o in observations} == set(items) else "partial"
    write_json(bundle_path, bundle)
    return observation


def _facts_for_review(compiled: compiler.CompiledProfile, facts_record: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """The declared facts plus every optional declared fact with its effective value, so an omitted one
    (absent means false) is visible to CORE-ACTIVATION-FACTS instead of silently off (Plan #59)."""
    shown: dict[str, Any] = dict(facts_record["facts"])
    for name in compiler.OPTIONAL_DECLARED_FACTS:
        if name not in shown or compiled.fact_origins.get(name, "").startswith("derived:"):
            value = compiled.facts.get(name, False)
            origin = compiled.fact_origins.get(name, "default:not_declared")
            shown[name] = f"{str(value).lower()} ({origin})"
    return shown


def declare_facts(
    *, repo_root: Path, plan_path: Path, path_decision_path: Path, facts: dict[str, bool], sources: dict[str, str]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    record = {
        "schema_version": "method-activation-facts.v1",
        "record_type": "method_activation_facts",
        "plan_ref": relative_ref(repo_root, plan_path),
        "plan_sha256": sha256_file(plan_path),
        "path_decision_ref": relative_ref(repo_root, path_decision_path),
        "path_decision_sha256": sha256_file(path_decision_path),
        "facts": facts,
        "fact_sources": sources,
        "recorded_at": now_iso(),
    }
    errors = schema_errors("facts", record)
    if errors:
        raise MethodConformanceError("invalid_activation_facts", "; ".join(errors))
    return record


def compile_bundle(inputs: GateInputs) -> dict[str, Any]:
    repo_root = inputs.repo_root.resolve()
    plan_ref = relative_ref(repo_root, inputs.plan_path)
    compiled = compiler.compile_profile(
        profile_id=inputs.profile_id,
        plan_ref=plan_ref,
        plan_sha256=sha256_file(inputs.plan_path),
        path_record=load_json(inputs.path_decision_path),
        path_sha256=sha256_file(inputs.path_decision_path),
        facts_record=load_json(inputs.facts_path),
        facts_sha256=sha256_file(inputs.facts_path),
        repo_root=repo_root,
    )
    bundle = {
        "schema_version": "checklist-evidence-bundle.v1",
        "record_type": "checklist_evidence_bundle",
        "bundle_id": f"BUNDLE-{safe_id(Path(plan_ref).stem)}",
        "coverage": "partial",
        "definition": compiled.definition,
        "observations": [],
    }
    return bundle

]
